ex.q: Write an email to introduce yourself to the employees (you are a new network administrator responsible for firewalls, security levels, wireless connection, usernames and passwords).
ex.model: Dear Colleagues, My name is Ahmed Ali and I am the new network administrator. I am responsible for setting up firewalls, security levels, wireless connection, usernames and passwords. My office is in building 8. My contact number is 675 000 111. Please contact me if you have any problem with the network. Best regards, Ahmed Ali
